agent-tuning.tuning.h1-1.text: Let your coding agent pick the model.

agent-tuning.p-1.text: Choosing a model for your cards means choosing a quantisation, an engine (vLLM or llama.cpp), how to split it across GPUs, how much context to give it, the KV-cache type and whether speculative decoding helps. Each guess costs a download and a load. A coding agent can run that search for you while you do something else, because everything the console does is an API call.

agent-tuning.h2-1.text: Set it up in three steps

agent-tuning.li-1.text: Install LM Warden on the GPU host (the command is under Download & Install) and finish the setup wizard.

agent-tuning.li-2.text: Issue an admin token in Settings → Access Tokens, with an expiry of 30 days. Export it as VW_ADMIN_TOKEN and the warden’s address as W in the shell your agent uses.

agent-tuning.li-3.text: Start your agent: Claude Code, Codex CLI or another one that can run shell commands. It can use a hosted model for this job; the model it is tuning is the one on your cards.

agent-tuning.th-4.text: Check a model fits, before downloading

agent-tuning.p-2.text: The agent reads the agent guide first: a short description of these calls written for a language model, with the mistakes to avoid.

agent-tuning.p-3.text: Replace https://your-warden with your warden’s address, and the capitalised names with models you have in mind.

agent-tuning.h3-1.text: 1. Survey the hardware and shortlist models

agent-tuning.h3-2.text: 2. Choose the engine and layout for one model

agent-tuning.h3-3.text: 3. Find the real limits and apply them

agent-tuning.h3-4.text: 4. Compare two candidates on my workload

agent-tuning.li-4.text: An admin token has full admin rights over the warden: models, keys and settings. There are no narrower scopes yet. Give it a short expiry.

agent-tuning.li-5.text: A stress run deliberately crashes an engine to find its limit. Run these prompts on a warden nobody else depends on.

agent-tuning.li-6.text: Downloads are large. The prompts ask the agent to check fit before pulling, but watch your disk.

agent-tuning.li-7.text: Revoke the admin token in Settings → Access Tokens when the job is done.
